'''Spinsticks''' were a type of weapon that were viewed by some individuals as esoteric<ref name="Twilight" /> by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> The weapons were utilized by some members of the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gray Paladin]]s&mdash;an offshoot of the [[Teepo Paladins]]&mdash;who were themselves a part of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The Gray Paladins used weapons such as spinsticks to avoid relying on [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] or [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], the traditional weapons of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="Twilight" />

==Behind the scenes==
Spinsticks were first mentioned in ''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]'', a [[2008]] novel written by [[Michael Reaves]].<ref name="Twilight" /> On [[March]] [[March 11|11]], [[2011]],<ref name="Airdate">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode320.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Citadel Rescue}}</ref> "[[Citadel Rescue]]," an episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell's]] [[Death/Legends|death]] to occur in the episode,<ref name="Citadel">{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}}</ref> instead of the novel,<ref name="Twilight">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref> making it ambiguous how the events of the novel fit in with the altered continuity.
